installationAndStart.summary: Reviewed public AIM 4.8.5 installation, upgrade and School empty/existing-repository paths. Standard skills CLI retrieves the complete GitHub package; project start calibrates missing/stale repository knowledge and configures role skills without treating global installation as project setup. Existing-repository guide remains read-only until a supplied intent, preserves user files and accepted history, and routes approved-scope changes to the explicit human disposition contract. Public release follows the reviewed source/tag/Actions gates; no automatic project-ledger mutation.

deliveryModes.summary: Homepage and School consistently default new work to Ship, reserve Loop for actual feedback on useful increments, and separate delivery style from Strict/Auto and cost depth. School explicitly chooses Ship/Auto and grants bounded plan approval only after confirming scope/resources. This is an explicit example mandate, not an unselected default or invented acceptance. Existing frozen deliveries retain their original policy.

orchestration.summary: Homepage Native graph descriptions and School planning lesson preserve outcome/dependency/proof ownership, cohesive implementation and a genuinely separate reviewer. Host tools actually launch/message agents; assignments and UI Graph do not. Current installed entry requires read-only dispatch-check plus the same exact CAS activity start before normal host dispatch. Beginner guidance does not replace approved/activated delivery with a ready card or diagram; its linked Native contract explains those checks and arbitrary-host interception limits. The Graph engineering illustration is a conceptual bridge-building scene; the concise introduction retains independent review and designated-owner feedback. Expanded details preserve Native defaults, graph choices, durable attempts/results, delegated decision/resource limits and host-launch boundaries.

delegatedDecisions.summary: Homepage escalation and School delegation preserve explicit scope, resources and owner acceptance boundaries. The linked Story contract now permits only an actual present human to cancel or replace approved unaccepted work through a scoped typed decision. Existing approve/accept/orchestrate delegation and Auto cannot authorize this changed commitment. Each replacement is a separately unapproved plan; no past gate or final acceptance is invented.

resourceUse.summary: School counts planning, implementation, review, integration and correction resources and distinguishes attempts/tokens/time/money. Cancellation/replacement retains campaign observations, negative results, attempts and exhausted allowances. Only the obsolete Intent priority is removed from current dispatch ordering, with before/after recorded; unrelated priority remains. A new plan or session grants no resource renewal. Cost Control still requires quality and independent review.

verificationAndAcceptance.summary: Ordinary homepage/School flow preserves early proof, separate review, delivered-version journeys and actual final owner acceptance. The linked Story contract adds human cancellation/replacement as terminal non-acceptance, retaining the old frozen delivery and proof. Released cards return to draft; a replacement needs new Gate A/B. UI distinguishes approved cancellation from unapproved plan cancellation. Existing scoped Native acceptance reconciliation remains separate; no Epic closure or performance gain follows from disposition.

modelsAndEvidence.summary: Homepage visibly dates the96.5/100 assessed AIM result to18October2026 and49.8 baseline to30September, links exact tested provenance, and retains differing conditions, unfinished Native delivery and absence of a fresh paired or general quality/cost result. AIM4.8.4 inherits no new Enigma performance measurement. Dated4.7.5 UI screenshots remain historical. School Sol/Luna allocation is optional creator experience, conditional on actual host/account controls, with no current price, universal savings or model-availability guarantee.
